title: The Pink Cowgirl Halloween Costume
intro: Everyone does the brown suede cowgirl. This one keeps the dress white and lets the hat, the boots and the fringe do the talking, so it reads Legally Blonde from across the room. The dress and boots are the pieces you will actually wear again.

sections.heading: A white dress keeps the pink loud
paragraphs: The white square neck corset mini dress is the backbone here, and it is doing more than it looks like. In the flat lay you can see the ruching at the bust and waist and the two tiered layers in the skirt. On me in the mirror selfie that ruching is what pulls it in, and the layers give it swing when you walk.

Because it is fitted through the middle, sizing matters. Check the size chart on the listing and measure your waist, not just your usual letter size. White can be a little sheer depending on the fabric, so wear nude underwear, not white. White glows. You will see it in every flash photo.

Already own a white sundress or a white skater dress? Use it. The costume lives in the accessories, so a dress from your closet gets you most of the way there. The only thing I would check is the neckline. A square or sweetheart neck frames the bandana better than a crew neck does, and it makes the whole outfit look more on purpose and less thrown together at six pm.

sections.heading: The hat and boots carry the theme
paragraphs: The hot pink cowboy hat comes with a wide belt band, and in the flat lay you can see the dark band with silver hardware around the crown. That contrast keeps the hat from looking like a party store hat. Hat sizing is usually listed by head measurement, so wrap a soft tape measure around your forehead before you order. A loose hat on a windy night is not cute.

The pink mid calf cowboy boots have white western stitching and a stacked heel that is low enough to stand in all night. Mid calf is the sweet spot with a short dress. They hit right under the knee on me, which you can see in the selfie. Western boots can run narrow, so read the fit notes on the listing and break them in around the house first.

Bring the hat in your hand for the car ride. Wide brims and car headliners do not get along, and nobody wants a dent in the crown before the first photo is even taken. Same goes for the boots on a long drive. Slip them off, wear sneakers to the door, then switch.

sections.heading: Fringe, stars and the bandana trick
paragraphs: The hot pink fringe crossbody phone bag is small, which is the point. Phone, lipstick, ID, card. That is it. Wear it crossbody like in the photo so the fringe swings at your hip and both hands stay free for a drink and a photo.

The pink crystal star tassel earrings are long, so wear your hair down and tuck one side behind your ear so they actually show under the hat brim. The hot pink paisley bandana comes as a two pack. I folded one into a triangle and tied it loosely at my neck like a kerchief, knot in the back. Tie the second one on the bag strap or give it to a friend who showed up costume-less, which happens every year.

sections.heading: Comfort and what you keep
paragraphs: Halloween nights cool off fast and this is a sleeveless mini. Throw a white or denim jacket over your shoulders for walking between houses and take it off for photos. Bike shorts under the skirt are a smart move if there is any dancing or any stairs. Hair is easy, loose waves under the hat, and a pink lip. Skip big hair, the hat flattens it anyway. Pink nails if you have time, because the phone is always in the photo.

The pink pumpkins and folded cloth in the flat lay are styling extras, and so is the pink blanket on the bed behind me. What keeps earning its spot after October is the dress and the boots. The dress works for showers and summer dinners. The boots go with denim shorts all summer and jeans all fall.
